review.title: Cut Off at B3, Closed Out at C8
review.summary: The 20k won by resignation, and GPT-6.1 Sol was already behind before the large errors began. Black's lead slid from -0.1 to -8.2 over the first ten moves, then 11 B3 lost 9.8 points and left Black at -18.0. The 20k gave a lot back with its own slips, including 20 C8 (13.2 points lost), but GPT-6.1 Sol answered with 21 B7, which lost 13.2 points and put Black at -18.1, and never got back into the game.

moments.text: E4 lost 4.8 points and took Black from -1.4 to -6.2, the biggest drop of the opening. The engine preferred D5. The stones at E4 and E5 form a column that the 20k's D4 and D6 stones sit beside.

B3 lost 9.8 points, from -8.2 to -18.0, and the engine's choice was D5. The board before the move shows Black's C3 stone beside White's C4 and D3 stones. B3 added a second stone down there, and White's B4 reply was worth a 12.6-point swing back toward Black's side of the ledger.

B4 was the 20k's biggest slip: it lost 12.6 points, taking the score from -18.0 to -5.3, and the engine would have played D2. It handed GPT-6.1 Sol a way back into the game. Black's D2 next was the engine's own choice and lost 0.0.

E2 lost 11.0 points and moved Black from -3.1 to -14.2, after it had nearly caught up. The engine wanted G7. Black spent the move on the bottom edge while White's stones on D5, D6 and F7 were still open on the upper side.

The 20k's C8 had just lost 13.2 points, which brought the score to -4.9, but B7 lost 13.2 points straight back, to -18.1. The engine's choice was D7, which White then played at move 22. After that the left side filled with White stones and Black needed more than the board offered, and GPT-6.1 Sol resigned.

audit.reason: The `inspect`/`turn` code (commands 4-5 onward) only parses the board, lists chains, liberties and empty regions, and applies the one move the player named to compute its immediate captures. The other commands persisted audit files, replayed the move list into an SGF, and wrote notes, and none of it looped over candidate moves or looked ahead.
